_comment: The Ivory Compact commander's paths. At level 2 the player chooses one path for good; each later level grants that path's skill for the level. Effects: tactics (stacks ordered first), attack/defense (every troop stack), readied_shot (archers fire at stacks moving closer), moves (per day), sight, gold (a day), growth (weekly recruits, +fraction). A skill without an effect is not in the demo yet. The Veined is the wildcard: offered by the story, never chosen at level 2.

paths.name: Marshal
paths.text: Leads the line: who moves first, and how hard they hit.

nodes.name: First Orders
nodes.text: Before each battle, order one of your stacks to act first, ahead of every enemy.

nodes.name: Rally
nodes.text: +1 attack for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Vanguard
nodes.text: Order two stacks to open the battle, in the order you set.

nodes.name: Battle Plan
nodes.text: Order three stacks to open the battle.

nodes.name: Banner
nodes.text: One stack carries a banner: +2 defence to stacks beside it.

nodes.name: Hold the Line
nodes.text: Defending stacks also strike anyone who steps away from them.

nodes.name: Wider Banner
nodes.text: The banner reaches two hexes, and companions' auras grow too.

nodes.name: Oathbound
nodes.text: Once per battle, a stack cannot be wiped out this round.

nodes.name: Marshal of the Compact
nodes.text: Your name alone steadies a wavering line.

paths.name: Siegemaster
paths.text: Steel and timber: the battlefield is built before the battle.

nodes.name: Palisade
nodes.text: +2 defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Stakes and Pavises
nodes.text: Your archers fire at any stack that moves closer (once a round).

nodes.name: Earthworks
nodes.text: +1 more defence for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Siege Drill
nodes.text: +1 attack for every troop stack.

nodes.name: Caltrops
nodes.text: Scatter caltrops: hexes that stop whoever walks in.

nodes.name: Field Wall
nodes.text: Raise a timber wall across three hexes.

nodes.name: Ballista Crew
nodes.text: A ballista fights from your back line.

nodes.name: Undermine
nodes.text: Sappers weaken a town's walls before you attack.

nodes.name: Master of Sieges
nodes.text: No wall stands long against you.

paths.name: Quartermaster
paths.text: Wars are won on the road: marches, scouts, silver and supply.

nodes.name: Forced March
nodes.text: +2 movement every day.

nodes.name: Pathfinders
nodes.text: +2 sight: outriders see what waits ahead.

nodes.name: Requisition
nodes.text: +250 gold a day.

nodes.name: Supply Lines
nodes.text: +25% weekly recruits in your towns.

nodes.name: Caravans
nodes.text: Trade at a better rate at your markets.

nodes.name: Remounts
nodes.text: Stables refresh your horses for the whole week, everywhere.

nodes.name: Spymaster
nodes.text: See rival war-bands through the fog.

nodes.name: War Chest
nodes.text: Companions' upkeep halved.

nodes.name: Quartermaster-General
nodes.text: The Compact's roads run wherever you ride.

wildcard.name: The Veined
wildcard.text: Not the Compact's. What the obelisks teach, offered by the story, to anyone, at a price.

nodes.name: Vein Sight
nodes.text: See through the fog along the veins.

nodes.name: Grave Harvest
nodes.text: Raise the lowest dead of your enemies after battle.

nodes.name: Listen Below
nodes.text: Hear what is under the map.
